stem: In an office, 30 men have an average weight of 65 kg and 20 women have an average weight of 55 kg. What is the average weight of all 50 employees?
hints: There are more men than women. Can you just take halfway between 65 and 55?
Find each group's total: men 30 × 65, women 20 × 55.
Add the two totals, then divide by the 50 employees.

solution.methodName: Weighted average: add group totals, divide by total count

steps.why: Total = average × count. By hand: 3 × 65 = 195, then × 10 = 1,950.
By hand: 3,050 ÷ 50 is the same as 305 ÷ 5 = 61.

trapNotes.60 kg: This is halfway between 65 and 55. That only works when the groups are the same size. There are more men, so the average is closer to 65.
trapNotes.59 kg: This mixes up the groups: 30 × 55 + 20 × 65. There are 30 men at 65 kg and 20 women at 55 kg.
trapNotes.3,050 kg: This is the total weight of all 50 people. Divide it by 50 to get the average.
